Each lane keeps its own sum over j in\n// the same order as the serial loop, so results are bit-identical while the lane loop\n// maps onto SIMD registers.\nconstexpr size_t LANES = 8;\n\nstruct Vec3 {\n    double x, y, z;\n    constexpr Vec3(const double x = 0, const double y = 0, const double z = 0) noexcept : x(x), y(y), z(z) {}\n};\n\n// Block distribution of bodies over MPI ranks\nstruct Decomposition {\n    std::vector<int> counts;     // bodies owned by each rank\n    std::vector<int> displs;     // first body owned by each rank\n    std::vector<int> xyzCounts;  // doubles owned by each rank (3 per body)\n    std::vector<int> xyzDispls;  // first double owned by each rank\n\n    Decomposition(const int numBodies, const int numRanks)\n        : counts(numRanks), displs(numRanks), xyzCounts(numRanks), xyzDispls(numRanks) {\n        const int base = numBodies / numRanks;\n        const int extra = numBodies % numRanks;\n        int offset = 0;\n        for (int r = 0; r < numRanks; ++r) {\n            counts[r] = base + (r < extra ? 1 : 0);\n            displs[r] = offset;\n            xyzCounts[r] = 3 * counts[r];\n            xyzDispls[r] = 3 * offset;\n            offset += counts[r];\n        }\n    }\n};\n\nvoid randomizeBodies(std::vector<Vec3>& pos, std::vector<Vec3>& vel, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < pos.size(); ++i) {\n        pos[i].x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        pos[i].y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        pos[i].z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        vel[i].x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        vel[i].y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        vel[i].z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Updates velocities of bodies [begin, end) using the positions of all bodies\nvoid computeForces(const std::vector<Vec3>& pos, std::vector<Vec3>& vel, size_t begin, size_t end) {\n    const size_t n = pos.size();\n\n    for (size_t i0 = begin; i0 < end; i0 += LANES) {\n        const size_t lanes = std::min(LANES, end - i0);\n\n        // Unused trailing lanes repeat the last valid body; their results are discarded\n        double xi[LANES], yi[LANES], zi[LANES];\n        double Fx[LANES] = {}, Fy[LANES] = {}, Fz[LANES] = {};\n        for (size_t l = 0; l < LANES; ++l) {\n            const Vec3& p = pos[i0 + std::min(l, lanes - 1)];\n            xi[l] = p.x;\n            yi[l] = p.y;\n            zi[l] = p.z;\n        }\n\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            const Vec3& pj = pos[j];\n            for (size_t l = 0; l < LANES; ++l) {\n                const double dx = pj.x - xi[l];\n                const double dy = pj.y - yi[l];\n                const double dz = pj.z - zi[l];\n                const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;\n                const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);\n                const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;\n\n                Fx[l] += dx * invDist3;\n                Fy[l] += dy * invDist3;\n                Fz[l] += dz * invDist3;\n            }\n        }\n\n        for (size_t l = 0; l < lanes; ++l) {\n            vel[i0 + l].x += DT * Fx[l];\n            vel[i0 + l].y += DT * Fy[l];\n            vel[i0 + l].z += DT * Fz[l];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nvoid integrateBodies(std::vector<Vec3>& pos, const std::vector<Vec3>& vel, size_t begin, size_t end) {\n    for (size_t i = begin; i < end; ++i) {\n        pos[i].x += vel[i].x * DT;\n        pos[i].y += vel[i].y * DT;\n        pos[i].z += vel[i].z * DT;\n    }\n}\n\n// Shares each rank's owned slice of v with every rank, in place\nvoid allgatherVec3(std::vector<Vec3>& v, const Decomposition& dec) {\n    MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DOUBLE, v.data(), dec.xyzCounts.data(), dec.xyzDispls.data(),\n                   MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n}\n\n// The pair terms are split across ranks and reduced, so their rounding order differs from a serial sum\ndouble computeTotalEnergy(const std::vector<Vec3>& pos, const std::vector<Vec3>& vel, size_t rank, size_t size) {\n    const size_t n = pos.size();\n\n    // Kinetic energy (assuming unit mass)\n    double kinetic = 0.0;\n    for (const auto& v : vel) {\n        kinetic += 0.5 * (v.x * v.x + v.y * v.y + v.z * v.z);\n    }\n\n    // Potential energy (assuming unit mass for all bodies). Interleaved rows balance the i<j workload.\n    double potential = 0.0;\n    for (size_t i = rank; i < n; i += size) {\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = pos[j].x - pos[i].x;\n            const double dy = pos[j].y - pos[i].y;\n            const double dz = pos[j].z - pos[i].z;\n            const double dist = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + return kinetic - totalPotential;\n}\n\n// Validate that simulation produces finite, reasonable values.\n// Returns nullptr if valid, otherwise a message describing the first failure.\nconst char* validateSimulation(const std::vector<Vec3>& pos, const std::vector<Vec3>& vel) {\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < pos.size(); ++i) {\n        const Vec3& p = pos[i];\n        const Vec3& v = vel[i];\n\n        // Check for NaN or Inf values\n        if (!std::isfinite(p.x) || !std::isfinite(p.y) || !std::isfinite(p.z) ||\n            !std::isfinite(v.x) || !std::isfinite(v.y) || !std::isfinite(v.z)) {\n            return \"Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value in body state\\n\";\n        }\n\n        // Check for extreme values (bodies shouldn't fly off to infinity)\n        const double maxPos = 1e6;\n        const double maxVel = 1e6;\n        if (std::abs(p.x) > maxPos || std::abs(p.y) > maxPos || std::abs(p.z) > maxPos) {\n            return \"Validation failed: body position exceeds reasonable bounds\\n\";\n        }\n        if (std::abs(v.x) > maxVel || std::abs(v.y) > maxVel || std::abs(v.z) > maxVel) {\n            return \"Validation failed: body velocity exceeds reasonable bounds\\n\";\n        }\n    }\n    return nullptr;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of bodies (default: 1024)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Number of simulation steps (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation (checks energy conservation)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint run(int argc, char** argv, int rank, int size) {\n    const bool root = rank == 0;\n\n    int numBodies = 1024;\n    int numSteps = 10;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numBodies = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numSteps = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"N-Body Simulation\\n\");\n        printf(\"Number of bodies: %d\\n\", numBodies);\n        printf(\"Number of steps: %d\\n\", numSteps);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    }\n\n    // Every rank builds the same initial state, so no initial broadcast is needed\n    const Decomposition dec(numBodies, size);\n    std::vector<Vec3> pos(numBodies), vel(numBodies);\n    randomizeBodies(pos, vel);\n\n    const size_t begin = dec.displs[rank];\n    const size_t end = begin + dec.counts[rank];\n\n    // Run simulation\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    const double start = MPI_Wtime();\n\n    for (int step = 0; step < numSteps; ++step) {\n        computeForces(pos, vel, begin, end);\n        integrateBodies(pos, vel, begin, end);\n        allgatherVec3(pos, dec);\n    }\n\n    const double elapsed = MPI_Wtime() - start;\n    double maxElapsed = 0.0;\n    MPI_Reduce(&elapsed, &maxElapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Simulation time: %ld ms\\n\", static_cast<long>(maxElapsed * 1000.0));\n    }\n\n    // Velocities are only held locally until here; every rank needs the full state for output and validation\n    if (printResults || validate) {\n        allgatherVec3(vel, dec);\n    }\n\n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults && root) {\n        // Serialize body positions and velocities for hashing\n        std::vector<double> bodyData;\n        bodyData.reserve(numBodies * 6);\n        for (int i = 0; i < i < end; ++i) {\n        pos[i].x += vel[i].x * DT;\n        pos[i].y += vel[i].y * DT;\n        pos[i].z += vel[i].z * DT;\n    }\n}\n\n// Shares each rank's owned slice of v with every rank, in place\nvoid allgatherVec3(std::vector<Vec3>& v, const Decomposition& dec) {\n    MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DOUBLE, v.data(), dec.xyzCounts.data(), dec.xyzDispls.data(),\n                   MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n}\n\n// The pair terms are split across ranks and reduced, so their rounding order differs from a serial sum\ndouble computeTotalEnergy(const std::vector<Vec3>& pos, const std::vector<Vec3>& vel, size_t rank, size_t size) {\n    const size_t n = pos.size();\n\n    // Kinetic energy (assuming unit mass)\n    double kinetic = 0.0;\n    for (const auto& v : vel) {\n        kinetic += 0.5 * (v.x * v.x + v.y * v.y + v.z * v.z);\n    }\n\n    // Potential energy (assuming unit mass for all bodies). Interleaved rows balance the i<j workload.\n    double potential = 0.0;\n    for (size_t i = rank; i < n; i += size) {\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = pos[j].x - pos[i].x;\n            const double dy = pos[j].y - pos[i].y;\n            const double dz = pos[j].z - pos[i].z;\n            const double dist = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);\n            potential += 1.0 / dist;\n        }\n    }\n\n    double totalPotential = 0.0;\n    MPI_Allreduce(&potential, &totalPotential, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_SUM, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    return kinetic - totalPotential;\n}\n\n// Validate that simulation produces finite, reasonable values.\n// Returns nullptr if valid, otherwise a message describing the first failure.\nconst char* validateSimulation(const std::vector<Vec3>& pos, const std::vector<Vec3>& vel) {\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < pos.size(); ++i) {\n        const Vec3& p = pos[i];\n        const Vec3& v = vel[i];\n\n        // Check for NaN or Inf values\n        if (!std::isfinite(p.x) || !std::isfinite(p.y) || !std::isfinite(p.z) ||\n            !std::isfinite(v.x) || !std::isfinite(v.y) || !std::isfinite(v.z)) {\n            return \"Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value in body state\\n\";\n        }\n\n        // Check for extreme values (bodies shouldn't fly off to infinity)\n        const double maxPos = 1e6;\n        const double maxVel = 1e6;\n        if (std::abs(p.x) > maxPos || std::abs(p.y) > maxPos || std::abs(p.z) > maxPos) {\n            return \"Validation failed: body position exceeds reasonable bounds\\n\";\n        }\n        if (std::abs(v.x) > maxVel || std::abs(v.y) > maxVel || std::abs(v.z) > maxVel) {\n            return \"Validation failed: body velocity exceeds reasonable bounds\\n\";\n        }\n    }\n    return nullptr;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of bodies (default: 1024)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Number of simulation steps (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation (checks energy conservation)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint run(int argc, char** argv, int rank, int size) {\n    const bool root = rank == 0;\n\n    int numBodies = 1024;\n    int numSteps = 10;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numBodies = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numSteps = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"N-Body Simulation\\n\");\n        printf(\"Number of bodies: %d\\n\", numBodies);\n        printf(\"Number of steps: %d\\n\", numSteps);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    }\n\n    // Every rank builds the same initial state, so no initial broadcast is needed\n    const Decomposition dec(numBodies, size);\n    std::vector<Vec3> pos(numBodies), vel(numBodies);\n    randomizeBodies(pos, vel);\n\n    const size_t begin = dec.displs[rank];\n    const size_t end = begin + dec.counts[rank];\n\n    // Run simulation\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    const double start = MPI_Wtime();\n\n    for (int step = 0; step < numSteps; ++step) {\n        computeForces(pos, vel, begin, end);\n        integrateBodies(pos, vel, begin, end);\n        allgatherVec3(pos, dec);\n    }\n\n    const double elapsed = MPI_Wtime() - start;\n    double maxElapsed = 0.0;\n    MPI_Reduce(&elapsed, &maxElapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Simulation time: %ld ms\\n\", static_cast<long>(maxElapsed * 1000.0));\n    }\n\n    // Velocities are only held locally until here; every rank needs the full state for output and validation\n    if (printResults || validate) {\n        allgatherVec3(vel, dec);\n    }\n\n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults && root) {\n        // Serialize body positions and velocities for hashing\n        std::vector<double> bodyData;\n        bodyData.reserve(numBodies * 6);\n        for (int i = 0; i < numBodies; ++i) {\n            bodyData.push_back(pos[i].x);\n            bodyData.push_back(pos[i].y);\n            bodyData.push_back(pos[i].z);\n            bodyData.push_back(vel[i].x);\n            bodyData.push_back(vel[i].y);\n            bodyData.push_back(vel[i].z);\n        }\n        print_results(bodyData, \"Bodies\");\n    }\n\n    // Validation: check that simulation produces finite, reasonable values\n    if (validate) {\n        if (root) printf(\"Validating simulation results...\\n\");\n\n        const char* failure = validateSimulation(pos, vel);\n        if (failure == nullptr) {\n            // Report final energy for reference\n            const double finalEnergy = computeTotalEnergy(pos, vel, rank, size);\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Final energy: %.6f\\n\", finalEnergy);\n                printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            }\n            return 0;\n        }\n\n        if (root) {\n            printf(\"%s\", failure);\n            printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n        }\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    return 0;\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n\n    int rank = 0;\n    int size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &size);\n\n    const int status = run(argc, argv, rank, size);\n\n    MPI_Finalize();\n    return status;\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":1,"oldLines":4,"newStart":1,"newLines":6,"lines":["-#include <chrono>","+#include <mpi.h>","+","+#include <algorithm>"," #include <cmath>"," #include <cstdio>"," #include <cstdlib>"]},{"oldStart":10,"oldLines":108,"newStart":12,"newLines":155,"lines":[" constexpr double SOFTENING = 1e-9;"," constexpr double DT = 0.01;"," ","+// Bodies whose forces are accumulated together. / std::sqrt(distSqr);\n            const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;\n            \n            Fx += dx * invDist3;\n            Fy += dy * invDist3;\n            Fz += dz * invDist3;\n        }\n        \n        bodies[i].vel.x += DT * Fx;\n        bodies[i].vel.y += DT * Fy;\n        bodies[i].vel.z += DT * Fz;\n    }\n}\n\nvoid integrateBodies(std::vector<Body>& computeTotalEnergy(const std::vector<Body>& bodies) {\n    double energy = 0.0;\n    const size_t n = bodies.size();\n    \n    // Kinetic energy (assuming unit mass)\n    for (const auto& body :      const double dy = bodies[j].pos.y - bodies[i].pos.y;\n            const double dz = bodies[j].pos.z - bodies[i].pos.z;\n            const double dist = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);\n            energy -= 1.0 / dist;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return energy;\n}\n\n// Validate that simulation produces finite, reasonable values\nbool validateSimulation(const Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int numBodies = 1024;\n    int numSteps = 10;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"N-Body Simulation\\n\");\n    printf(\"Number of bodies: %d\\n\", bodies(numBodies);\n    randomizeBodies(bodies);\n    \n    // Run simulation\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    for (int step = 0; step < numSteps; ++step) {\n        computeForces(bodies);\n        integrateBodies(bodies);\n    }\n    \n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg1jexHqRLvX5fqU1Eb41","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The nbody benchmark now runs under MPI, unconditionally. The output hashes match the original bit for bit at every process count I tried. I only changed `nbody/nbody.cpp` and `nbody/CMakeLists.txt`, and the executable is still `nbody`.\n\n**Design**\n- **Decomposition:** each rank owns a contiguous block of bodies and computes their forces. Every rank keeps a full copy of positions, refreshed each step with one `MPI_Allgatherv`.\n- **Kernel:** the inner loop handles 8 target bodies at once, with one accumulator per lane. Each body's sum still runs over j in the original order, so it vectorizes without reordering any floating-point sums.\n- **Output:** only rank 0 prints. Timing is the maximum across ranks. Exit codes match the original.\n- **Build:** `find_package(MPI REQUIRED)` and link `MPI::MPI_CXX`. No new dependencies.\n\n**Verification**\n- Built out-of-tree in `/tmp`, so no build artifacts landed in the repo. The build is warning-free.\n- `-r` hashes and sample values match the original for N = 0, 1, 3, 64, 100 (zero steps), 1000, and 4096, at 1 to 33 ranks.\n- N = 0, N smaller than the rank count, and zero steps all work.\n- Exit paths: `-h` returns 0, and an unknown option returns 1 on every rank.\n- Timing at N = 16384, 5 steps: 1 rank takes 7.7 s (original 10.1 s), 16 ranks take 0.55 s (about 14× over one rank). 32 ranks only reach 0.45 s; I didn't investigate why on this node.\n\n**Choices to review**\n- **`-ffp-contract=off` added to the compile flags.** Without it, the original's own output depends on whether the compiler fuses multiply-adds, so the default build and the no-contraction build give different hashes (`44ca…` vs `7f44…` at N=64). I pinned it off so the rounding is fixed regardless of loop shape. This costs about 8% in the kernel (1.28× vs 1.39× over the original). Remove the flag if you'd rather have that speed and don't need hashes to match a no-contraction build.\n- **Energy (`-v`) is computed in parallel.** The pair sum is split across ranks and reduced, so its rounding order differs from the original. At N = 1000 this moves the printed `Final energy` from `1807384.716202` to `1807384.716139`. The energy is a diagnostic, not simulation state, so I accepted the change. The velocity check and hash are unaffected.\n\n**Not verified**\n- Multi-node runs. I only tested on one node with Open MPI 4.x and oversubscription.\n- The validation-failure path (no input I tried produced NaN or out-of-bounds values).\n- `-march=native` means the binary needs the same CPU features on every node of a heterogeneous cluster.\n\nI didn't commit anything; the directory isn't a git repo."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":966,"cache_read_input_tokens":79577,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":966},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"df09408c-14e6-4f40-baac-bdaa524e6ec9","uuid":"f04f59eb-fbdb-4f3e-becd-5918e5dea5d7","timestamp":"2026-10-14T07:29:22.738Z","request_id":"req_011Cg1jewkLACdQbvaJpqYh2"}
